factorial.fixed_H: F_S + lambda_B D^T D / M + damping I
factorial.request_direction: u = delta_normal - delta_zero = H^-1 lambda_B D^T zeta / M

steps.finite_over_budget_policy: retain marked in primary diagnostic; secondary six-arm common-motion-feasible subset per beta
steps.nonfinite_policy: record numerical_failure; never treat as finite budget rejection

labels.candidate_phase: task-scoped source-fit labels only; no source-validation or target labels or metric tables
labels.evaluation_phase: after R6_OBS verify: full source-fit, source-validation and target labels
labels.target_gradients: evaluation diagnostic only; never update candidates, steps, selection or model

evaluation.subgroup_origin: old theta predictions and old generator graph IDs; evaluation only
evaluation.derivative_after_source: gradient(pool_nll at theta + beta*s) dot u for every fixed beta
evaluation.finite_difference_diagnostics: Delta L(beta*v), beta*d, nonlinear residual; no adaptive target-driven step search
evaluation.aggregation: each setting/time/step/contrast: equal 12 directions within each seed, then five seeds
evaluation.incomplete_seed: NA for full-direction seed; NA for complete-five-seed mean if any incomplete; optionally separately labeled conditional available-block statistics
evaluation.secondary_feasible_mask: same six-arm jointly feasible block set; no per-arm filtering
